phone.notes: The Battle tab now explains the stage limit: in fights a Digimon fights as the highest stage your tamer level allows. Requires Android 13 or newer.

watch.notes: BATTLE now opens the same fight as the wild Digimon for a Digimon of the farm, counted by the farm (5 fights an hour, 5% scan). Fixed the watch closing when BATTLE was selected with a card without its battle background.
